detail.overview: Ditch the bezels, embrace the brilliance. This 32" HD Smart TV boasts a frameless screen that maximizes your view and minimizes distraction. Dive into 16.7 million colors, brought to life by a powerful 24W front-firing speaker system. The smart remote puts a universe of entertainment at your fingertips, all housed in a sleek design that elevates your space as much as your viewing experience.
